mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% does not lead to negative 20-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) indicates weakening consumer demand, which negatively impacts corporate earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS declines for 3 consecutive months but 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE rises > 0.5% in 1 month but 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Industrial Production (INDPRO) above 1% MoM signals strengthening supply-side fundamentals, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO > 1% MoM does not lead to positive 20-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS decreases but 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) decline by more than 10% YoY and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises by more than 0.3% in the same period, it signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST declines > 10% YoY and UNRATE rises > 0.3%
failure_condition: If HOUST declines > 10% YoY and UNRATE rises > 0.3% but 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.2% in the same month, it signals a strengthening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS > 200,000 and UNRATE declines > 0.2% but 5-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion, a decrease in GDP (GDPC1) growth rate below 2% YoY signals a potential economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 growth < 2% YoY does not lead to negative 60-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances during a late-cycle expansion.
